intro: New Zealand is a parliamentary democracy with the British monarch as head of state.

chapters.title: How it works
text: Parliament has one chamber, elected by mixed-member proportional representation, with seats reserved for Māori voters. Christopher Luxon became prime minister in 2023.

chapters.title: Firsts
text: Jacinda Ardern became one of the world's youngest leaders in 2017.

keyTerms.meaning: A voting system mixing local seats and party lists.
